conventions.albedo: sRGB colour, KTX2 carries the sRGB transfer function (use SRGBColorSpace)
conventions.normal: tangent-space, OpenGL convention (+Y up, green = up), linear (NoColorSpace); z is not guaranteed unit length after ETC1S compression, renormalise in the shader
conventions.orm: linear packed: R = ambient occlusion, G = roughness, B = metalness (NoColorSpace)
conventions.tiling: seamless in both axes; wrap = repeat
conventions.ktx2: Basis Universal ETC1S + mipmaps (all 3 maps), transcode to BC7/ASTC/ETC2 with three KTX2Loader
conventions.webp: lossy WebP fallback, no mipmaps (generate at runtime)
